description: ADO-EDIT on a Mode=Read Connection: (a) a server keyset optimistic Recordset on SELECT ID, S FROM T: State, effective LockType, Supports adUpdate, set S = "ro", Update, EditMode, Errors, CancelUpdate, AddNew with S, Update, Delete; (b) a server keyset pessimistic request (effective LockType, edit of S, Update); (c) a client static batch optimistic Recordset (effective tuple, set S, UpdateBatch, Status, Errors); then the stored rows through Execute. Asks whether a read-mode connection refuses at open, at edit, at Update or UpdateBatch, and what the tuple reports.
